items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: We did those things at Bob Festein's studio

ctx.x: I tried not to out there and I couldn't, because nobody could hear you, either my stick is not clear enough or they're not used to following it anymore. It was all over the place and the only way to bring it together was the click track. That didn't happen in New York, but the engineer has a lot to do with that, how he places people.
We did those things at Bob Festein's studio and Bob (inaudible), which
they don't do anymore. Now everybody telephones his part, which is a terrible thing. It drives me insane. It makes for a lifeless recording.
